entries.packages/runtime/src/*.js: include_str! of packages/runtime/src/web.rs embeds each source into the runtime, which V8 evaluates; no import reaches it, and make test runs it through the Rust tests of packages/runtime

packages/build/tests/fixtures.reason: the shared npm fixture that the Rust tests of the packages build, render and drive in a browser by path, with the dependencies of its own package.json

entries.*.{ts,tsx,js,mjs,svelte}: the applications, client and server entries and browser scripts that the Rust tests build and run by path, and the browser scripts that tests/tools/browser-launch.test.mts runs; no import reaches them

ignoreDependencies.@fontsource/inter: only the Rust tests load it: the build of packages/build bundles the @import of app.css, a stylesheet that no JavaScript imports
ignoreDependencies.svelte: only the Rust tests load it: packages/build compiles the .svelte files with the svelte compiler of this project
ignoreDependencies.playwright-core: only the Rust tests load it: the browser scripts import it by a file URL into node_modules that the Rust tests pass, which knip cannot resolve
